description: Calculate the liquidation price for an isolated-margin futures position with one flat maintenance margin rate (mmr, which you supply from your exchange's tier). It is a generic flat-rate model, for linear and inverse alike, not any one exchange's engine. By default the maintenance margin is taken on the position value at the liquidation price (the form Bybit, KuCoin and Hyperliquid document); mmBase "entry" takes it on the entry value (the form MEXC documents); liqFeeRate adds a liquidation fee to the rate (KuCoin). No tiered maintenance amounts, no extra margin, no cross-margin (shared collateral) logic, so it does not apply to cross-margin accounts and can differ from an exchange's own figure. Use when user asks "where will I get liquidated?" or "how close is my liq price?". Returns: liqPrice (the price). liqPrice is null when the position cannot be liquidated: an inverse short whose margin covers any price rise (at 1x or less with the default mmBase; with mmBase "entry" only a little below 1x). Check for null before doing arithmetic on it.

contractType.description: linear = USDT-margined (default), inverse = coin-margined (e.g. Deribit/Bybit/MEXC BTC-settled perps).

liqFeeRate.description: Liquidation fee as a fraction of position value, default 0, max 0.05; added to mmr (e.g. KuCoin 0.0006).

mmBase.description: Value the maintenance margin is taken on: "liquidation" = position value at the liquidation price (default; Bybit, KuCoin, Hyperliquid), "entry" = entry value (MEXC).
